game_title: Digit Mill – Mine Cart Tunnel Streak
game_concept: A quiz RPG set in Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel, an old mine cart tunnel: the torchbearer must handle shadow wraiths while practicing control flow: while loops. Core idea – Digit Mill: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %.
theme: Shadow Cave – Mine Cart Tunnel: an old mine cart tunnel
core_gameplay_loop: In Mine Cart Tunnel, repeat each round: Peel digits off a number with while n > 0 using // and %. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the digits value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 8 consecutive correct decisions about digits to power up the torchbearer and open the mine cart.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 4 – Control Flow: While Loops | Level 2 (intro tier): Digit Mill
assets_style: dark pixel-art cavern: torchlit stone, mossy rock, deep shadows, glowing crystals; flat Kenney-style sprites; echoing drips, low drones and torch crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Digit Mill' (Week 4 slot 13), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Mine Cart Tunnel'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how digits changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow wraiths in Mine Cart Tunnel.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 8.
